answer: The strongest lever is simple: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because basalt only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, crystal is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any prism approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
